‘Then took They up Stones’

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

J
OHN
 
VIII.
 59
.
‘T
HEY
 took up stones.’ What meant they by such rage?
What wanted they with them? Their meaning’s plain:
’Tis their old father’s way.—O, sad presage!
He too took up the stones for bread amain.
